in_sanskrit.name: चिरग्राय
in_sanskrit.meaning: Chiras + Gar = Chirag + Ray = Shining Ray
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Shining Ray of Light on the Forehead

in_hindi.name: चिरग्राय
in_hindi.meaning: चिराग + राय = चिरग + राय = चिराग का राय = चिरकारी = Shining Ray
in_hindi.long_meaning: चिरकारी = Chirakari = One who shines or illuminates

in_tamil.name: சிரக்ராய
in_tamil.meaning: சிறப்பு + ராய் = சிறப்பில் இயல்பதையில் அளவும் இருக்கும் ராய் = Chirappu + Ray = Shining Ray
in_tamil.long_meaning: சிறப்பில் இயல்பதையில் அளவும் இருக்கும் ராய் = Chirappil Iyalpathil Avalvum Irukkum Ray = One who shines or illuminates in the forehead

in_telugu.name: చిరగ్రాయ
in_telugu.meaning: చిరగ్ + రాయ = చిరగ్ + రేయ = చిరకారీ = Shining Ray
in_telugu.long_meaning: చిరకారీ = Chirakari = One who shines or illuminates

in_marathi.name: Chiragray
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lamp of Rays
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chiragray हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chiragray is a mythological name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chirag', meaning 'lamp', and 'Ray' meaning 'rays'. This name is believed to symbolize the giver of light and guidance, illuminating the path for the bearer.
